description: This source file defines schema configuration functions for CLI11 command-line parser, specifically for CU-CP unit configuration in a 5G network context. It includes functions to set up command-line options for various network parameters, security, logging, metrics, and subcomponents like RLC, PDCP, and mobility settings.

methods.description: Configures CLI11 options for geographic location (latitude and longitude).

methods.description: Sets up CLI11 options for logging levels and hex dump size.
